scripts.types: cargo test --no-run -q -p patchwork-server && rm -rf apps/web/src/bindings && cargo test -q -p patchwork-server export_bindings && node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const dir="apps/web/src/bindings"; for(const file of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((name)=>name.endsWith(".ts"))){const path=dir+"/"+file; fs.writeFileSync(path,fs.readFileSync(path,"utf8").replace(/[ \t]+$/gm,""));}' && prettier --write "apps/web/src/bindings/*.ts"
scripts.check: pnpm types && pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
